messages:
ana: Ran into a weird combo of typing + bundling problems on the edge sample app. tsc fails during CI for the edge build, but local dev (node) is fine.

chris: can you paste the error and tsconfig? usually moduleResolution or types leak causes this.

ana: here's the core error from CI:

build-bot: 
```
> tsc -p tsconfig.edge.json
src/runtime/client.ts:45:19 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'T' is not assignable to parameter of type 'unknown'.
45   return client.call<T>(endpoint, payload)
                     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
src/runtime/client.d.ts:10:5 - error TS2300: Duplicate identifier 'CallOptions'.
10 export interface CallOptions { timeout?: number }
```

ana: tsconfig.edge.json has moduleResolution: "bundler", target: "es2021", lib: ["DOM","ES2021"], types includes ["node"]. we build with esbuild for the edge bundle.

mira: having "types": ["node"] with DOM/lib can cause duplicate decls at declaration emit. also declaration: true + bundling can produce multiple .d.ts entries if both cjs/esm pipeline run. try removing node types for the edge config.

raj: also check our package.exports/conditional exports. If the SDK exposes both cjs/esm and your bundler resolves the wrong entry it can pull node-only types into the edge build. we've seen require() -> commonjs entry importing node typedefs.

chris: quick checklist: 
- set "types": [] (or explicitly ["web"]) in tsconfig for edge
- ensure "declaration": false for the edge build artifacts (emit only for node packages)
- use moduleResolution: "node16"/"bundler" depending on bundler, but keep consistent with esbuild settings
- add "skipLibCheck": true to avoid stdlib dups during CI

ana: one other weird one: overload resolution + generics. I had an overloaded client.call with two signatures and a generic fallback, and TS infers any vs unknown depending on call site, which trips our strictUnknownChecks. snippet: 

```
// src/runtime/client.ts
export function call<T>(endpoint: string, payload: T): Promise<Response<T>>
export function call(endpoint: string, payload: unknown): Promise<Response<unknown>>
export function call(endpoint: string, payload: any) {
  // implementation
}
const foo = client.call('x', { a: 1 }) // inferred as any, not {a:number}
```

mira: overloads + generics are messy. TS picks the first overload that matches. If the generic signature is listed first the inference can collapse. Try reordering or provide a wrapper with explicit generic helper: 

```
export const callTyped = <T>(endpoint: string, payload: T) => client.call<T>(endpoint, payload)
```

chris: following up on default lib/type strategy for edge samples: in tsconfig.edge.json we added:
```
{"compilerOptions": {"lib": ["DOM","ES2021"], "types": [], "moduleResolution": "bundler", "skipLibCheck": true, "declaration": false}}
```
that fixed the duplicate identifier and d.ts noise for me locally.

raj: for the CJS/ESM exports issue, I prototyped an exports map that avoids node-only import paths for the browser/edge target. sample package.json snippet: 

```
"exports": {
  "./runtime": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/runtime.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/runtime.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/runtime.js"
  },
  "./browser": "./dist/browser/index.js"
}
```

Then consumers bundling for edge can explicitly import "sdk/browser" to avoid pulling node runtime.

ana: thanks. workarounds help but still a UX problem for new users. we should add an example repo with a minimal edge tsconfig + Vite/esbuild settings and a note about overload ordering/generic helper.

chris: agreed — I'll open a PR adding examples/edge-typing with: tsconfig.edge.json, vite config (ssr: false, define global fixes), a small wrapper callTyped util, and CI step that builds edge bundle with declaration disabled.

mira: also document the unknown vs any gotcha: recommend using unknown in public surface but provide a narrow generic wrapper for inference, and prefer explicit generic at call site for critical paths.

ana: created a quick repro gist for the overload inference problem: https://gist.github.com/ana/edge-overload-infer (contains minimial tsc + package.json to reproduce).

raj: I'll add the exports map change + tests to our SDK publishing pipeline so browser/edge entry points don't accidentally get the node-only paths.

chris: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 — it adds examples/edge-typing and CI tweaks.

ana: verified CI build now passes on my branch after the tsconfig + declaration=false change. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

mira: small followup — for customers using Cloudflare workers / V8 Isolates, call out "lib": ["DOM"], avoid node polyfills, and mention that using esbuild with target 'es2022' preserves bigint and other newer primitives.

ana: noted. closing this thread after PR merges.
